description: The fourth leaders' debate takes place
The third leaders' debate takes place and early voting begins
The second leaders' debate takes place
The first leaders' debate takes place
The 2025 Australian federal election is called for 3 May
The Liberals are re-elected in the 2024 Cook by-election
Labor is re-elected in the 2024 Dunkley by-election
The 2023 Australian Indigenous Voice referendum is defeated
LNP is re-elected in the 2023 Fadden by-election
Andrew Gee leaves the Nationals to become an independent
Peter Dutton elected unopposed as Leader of the Liberal Party
